turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
Be honest. On a scale of one to ten, how am I doing in this meeting?
I'm not grading you. Who decided on the zero?
And what's one thing I could do better?
My job isn't to fix your case. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, yes or no?
